The '''2014–15 Nebraska Cornhuskers men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Nebraska–Lincoln]] in the [[2014–15 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. Led by head coach [[Tim Miles]], in his third season, the Cornhuskers team played its home games at [[Pinnacle Bank Arena]] in downtown [[Lincoln, Nebraska]], and played its fourth season as a member of the [[Big Ten Conference]]. They finished the season 13–18, 5–13 in Big Ten play to finish in twelfth place. They lost in the first round of the [[2015 Big Ten Conference men's basketball tournament|Big Ten tournament]] to Penn State.

==Previous season==
The [[2013–14 Nebraska Cornhuskers men's basketball team|Cornhuskers]] finished the season with an overall record of 19–13, with a record of 11–7 in the Big Ten regular season. In the [[2014 Big Ten Conference men's basketball tournament|2014 Big Ten tournament]], the Cornhuskers were defeated by [[2013–14 Ohio State Buckeyes men's basketball team|Ohio State]], 71–67 in the quarterfinals.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.jconline.com/story/sports/college/2014/03/14/ohio-states-comeback-stuns-nebraska-in-big-ten-quarterfinal/6437151/|title=Ohio State’s comeback stuns Nebraska in Big Ten quarterfinal|work=[[Journal & Courier]]|first=Nathan|last=Baird|date=March 14, 2014|access-date=November 2, 2024}}</ref> They received at-large bid to the [[2014 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament]] for the first time since 1998. They lost in the second round to Baylor.
